status: Design handoff; runtime models, atlases, animation and performance validation are not implemented.

artDirection.name: Tactile stylized 3D
artDirection.forms: Intentional rounded silhouettes, smooth normals and modest bevels; broad material features that survive 64–96 px.
artDirection.lighting: Shared soft upper-left key, neutral ambient fill, restrained specular response; no asset-specific point lights.
artDirection.materials: Opaque satin surfaces for skins and creatures; matte grounded world props. Bake fine relief and markings. Surface appearance must remain distinct without physical transmission.
artDirection.colorHierarchy: Muted warm earth and olive world props; readable creature colors; saturated player cosmetics and controlled trail accents.

ui.text: Names, amounts and necessary controls only.

targets.note: Initial budgets, not benchmark results. Tune after profiling on target devices.

creature.rig: Merge rigid parts or skin to a small rig; preserve silhouettes and limb counts. Avoid a separate mesh/material per sphere, leg segment or eye.

obstacle.rendering: Merge each static prop to one mesh, batch repeated props with InstancedMesh and share one prop material/atlas.
obstacle.collision: One occupied tile as today; cosmetic shape does not alter occupancy or generate physics colliders.

trail.rendering: One ribbon texture with color/detail baked into it, one pooled sprite atlas draw. Reuse buffers; no per-frame object allocation, shadow casting, dynamic lights, postprocess bloom or simulated fluids.

sceneMobile.note: Includes world, creatures, player and effects; shadow pass is additional and must be measured. These budgets may require batching current world tiles as well as new props.

textures.runtime: Separate runtime UV atlases from these concept portraits. Use shared 1024px atlases by family, packed roughness/occlusion where useful, mipmaps and compressed GPU textures when supported. Load only equipped skin/trail into gameplay.
textures.portraits: Transparent PNG masters for Figma/UI reference. Produce responsive WebP UI exports at 256/512px when integrating. Static collection thumbnails; a single active hero canvas at most.
textures.avoid: Do not ship these full-resolution portraits as per-object 3D textures. They include preview lighting and are not UV-ready maps.

implementation.geometry: Build a common bevelled cube base. Use texture/material swaps for skins. Pool creatures and effects. Share geometry/materials; dispose only when a resource is no longer shared.
implementation.world: Use deterministic tile hash for prop selection. Keep existing obstacle spawn probability, safe-start tiles and movement rules.
implementation.animation: Animate a few rig bones or rigid transforms; wings via simple rotation, soft bodies via segment transforms. No cloth or fluid simulation.
implementation.quality: Cap render pixel ratio, allow lower shadow resolution or blob shadows on low tier, reduce trail particles first, then LOD geometry.
implementation.regression: Preserve gameplay stats, creature IDs, scoring, hit boxes, timers, obstacle occupancy and difficulty. Visual-only changes.

existingCodeFacts.note: 43 is the normal spawn threshold, not a guaranteed global cap; hatch paths need separate accounting.

cases: Peak late-level swarm including egg-sac hatching
Giant mode plus mass kills and score particles
Equipped trail plus dense obstacles during world streaming
Repeated menu opening and cosmetic switching
Low-tier mobile at capped DPR and thermal sustained play
measure: renderer.info.render.calls and triangles including shadow pass
GPU/JS memory growth after repeated runs
Effect overdraw and peak pool occupancy
profiling.acceptance: Record device, browser, resolution, quality tier and sustained frame-time results before claiming smooth performance.

assets.name: MAGMA
assets.implementation: Bake rock plate depth and fissure detail to normal/base-color maps; orange emissive mask, no per-crack lights.

assets.name: BOBA BUDDY
assets.implementation: Paint pearl motifs and cream swirls; only straw and cream silhouette need extra vertices; opaque caramel.

assets.name: GUMMY POP
assets.implementation: Opaque berry material with broad edge color; paint expression; no transmission or subsurface pass.

assets.name: GLACIER
assets.implementation: Opaque cyan material; bake cracks and frost; no internal shards or refraction.

assets.name: MOSSLING
assets.implementation: Bake moss microtexture and vines; broad moss silhouette plus one sprout/mushroom cluster merged into shell. No leaf particles.

assets.name: ARCADE
assets.implementation: Bake vents, fasteners and controls into normal/base-color maps; cyan eye mask, no separate render-to-texture screen.

assets.name: NEBULA
assets.implementation: Paint violet bands and stars; optional slow emissive-mask pulse, no volume rendering.

assets.name: HONEY DROP
assets.implementation: Bake honeycomb relief; merge short drips and cap into shell; opaque amber.

assets.name: TIDEPOOL
assets.implementation: Paint fish, coral and water bands onto opaque cube; no fish simulation or aquarium interior.

assets.name: PRISM
assets.implementation: Use baked pastel gradient with restrained specular highlight; no dispersion, transmission or screen-space reflections.

assets.name: ROOTED STUMP
assets.implementation: Bake fine material detail; geometry carries only outer silhouette and major cutouts.
